properties.description:
- Nodes have identity and 0..n independently identified components, including repeated types; replace node types with component types and typed properties.
- Implement the encapsulated engine first: owner-defined predicates, reusable cached views, scoped events and lazy consistent reads; retain typed node-to-node edges.
- Then rework all active owners and consumers; expose instances, component types, properties, data types and view definitions in the app.
- Use compiler-driven checks, independent agent reviews and commit checkpoints; only the completed experience requires human review.
properties.title: Migrate to component containers and lazy predicate views
